familySummary: Stayergo Shape pillows offer a compact rectangular profile for everyday sleeping comfort in a clean white finish.
familyDescription: The Stayergo Shape family brings together pillows designed in a compact rectangular form for everyday use in the bedroom. Their simple white look makes them easy to coordinate with a range of bedding styles. This pillow measures 50.5 × 34 × 10.5 cm and is made from Cotton and Polyester. It suits those looking for a shaped pillow format with a neat, understated appearance.
